_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: For everything there is a season under heaven.
A time to be born, and a time to die.
The One on the throne says: I make all things new.
I am the beginning and the end.
Whatever you did for the least of these, you did for me.
Lord, when did we see you? Teach us to see.
Come, let us worship at the turning of the year.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The old year closes and a new one opens, and the One seated on the throne says: See, I am making all things new.
Glory to God in the highest!
For everything there is a season — a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance.
Glory to God in the highest!
He will wipe every tear from our eyes; death and mourning and crying will be no more, for the old order has passed away.
Glory to God in the highest!
So we step into the new year looking for his face in the least of these, and we worship the Alpha and the Omega.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: For everything there is a season under heaven.
Glory to God in the highest!
Behold, says the Lord, I make all things new.
Glory to God in the highest!
He wipes every tear; the old has passed away.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us worship the beginning and the end.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
